notes.title: Join Our Official TikTok Community for Rat Chef
notes.notes:
Attention all gamers! We are thrilled to announce the official launch of our TikTok account for our beloved game. This is the perfect platform for all of our dedicated players to connect, share tips and strategies, and stay up-to-date on the latest game updates. Our TikTok account will be an active community where players can share their experiences, ask questions, and engage with one another in an interactive and fun environment.

We understand the importance of having a dedicated space for our players to come together, and we are excited to provide this opportunity for you. Following our TikTok account will give you access to exclusive content, updates, and the ability to participate in special events and giveaways.

If you are looking for a way to take your gaming experience to the next level, then look no further. Follow us on our TikTok account and become a part of our ever-growing community of dedicated players. Whether you're a new player looking for guidance or a seasoned veteran looking for a new challenge, our TikTok account is the perfect place for you.

So, what are you waiting for? Head on over to https://www.tiktok.com/@ratchef_official and follow our TikTok account today! We can't wait to see you there and engage in some exciting gaming action together. See you on TikTok!

notes.title: Delay in Game Release
notes.notes:
Dear gamers,

We regret to inform you that the release date for our game has been pushed back due to an unfortunate setback we encountered during the final stages of development. We lost an important file for the game and as a result, none of the animations are working properly, which are a crucial aspect of the gameplay experience.

We understand that many of you were eagerly awaiting the release of our game, and we apologize for any disappointment this delay may cause. As a gesture of goodwill, we would like to offer all of our players a 5% discount on the launch date of the game.

Rest assured, we are working diligently to resolve the issue and ensure that the final product is of the highest quality.

We appreciate your patience and understanding as we work to get the game back on track. Thank you for your continued support.
